success.description: You receive a general impression of the right direction to reach your destination, which you can discern as a manoeuvre at any time.

boon.description: You gain sufficient insight into the route to add {Df} to a single check related to continuing your journey.

sigmarsComet.description: You gain sufficient insight into the route to add {Df} to a single check related to continuing your journey.

reckless.requirements: 3 favour, must toss a coin into a body of water as you set out on a journey to a place you've never been before. Special: This card recharges when you reach your destination or when you set out on a new journey.
